name: Limite 1B - Violetto

lineage.how_derived: trained from scratch on under 300B curated tokens, then synthetic data, curated SFT and RL post-training (card)

purpose: Paradigma's first model, built for high-throughput solutions of difficult mathematical problems (card).

architecture.kind: dense 1B autoregressive transformer with speedrun-inspired changes (per-head attention gate before o_proj, attention softmax scale), custom code (LimiteForCausalLM)
architecture.why_this_design: Builder: sample efficiency from data curation plus an architecture strongly inspired by pre-training speedrun competitions (card).

variants.notes: repo total per HF API; 3.5k downloads, 146 likes

benchmarks.name: BeyondAIME
benchmarks.harness: card: MUSE-Glimmer-30B scores 70%; results across seven math benchmarks (AIME 2026, HMMT Feb 2026, APEX Shortlist, ...) are an image; some competitor numbers copied from model cards or MathArena

weaknesses: math only per its purpose statement
soft.maturity: First model of a new lab.

tona_fit.reason: A 1B math specialist: useful as a tiny verifier or math sub-worker, not as a coding model. The BeyondAIME claim needs our own run.
